text:
Rae: Quick sync: Crossover asked for a featured catalog listing, a short "how-to" webinar, and a 1k-word benchmark + integration post. We should scope owners and must decide publish windows.

Omar: I can own the marketplace/catalog listing and metadata. Need a 1200x600 hero, short blurb, and the 60s demo link. Prefer publish week of Jun 22.

Alex (Crossover): We can provide hero + 60s co-branded clip if you give a script. We can also amplify via our partner newsletter.

Li: I'll draft the benchmark blog. Plan: include latency & cost delta for prompt-heavy workflows with our cache + Crossover network. Need perf runs and the sample prompt set. Will add a small methodology section.

Nia: I'll run webinar ops and landing page. Proposed: Tue Jun 23, 11am PT. Format: 20m demo, 20m case study, 20m live Q&A. Need speakers and moderator.

partner-bot: Checklist required: assets, 60s video, legal signoff, UTM tags. Posting template in #ops-templates.

Rae: Two priority asks: 1) AE one-pager (top objections + quick rebuttals), 2) lead routing + SFDC tagging (marketplace -> Partner queue with partner tag).

Omar: Lead routing proposal (ops please implement):

```
source=partner_catalog
partner=crossover_net
campaign=crossover_catalog_jun2026
sfdc_owner=BD_Partners
lead_queue=partners_crossover
utm_source=crossover_catalog&utm_medium=partner&utm_campaign=crossover_catalog_jun2026
```

Li: On benchmark numbers  I'll run three setups: baseline, Redwood caching, Redwood + Crossover edge routing. If we see >=2x cost reduction on prefix-heavy flows, that's a good callout. Will post results by Fri EOD.

Nia: Promo cadence: announcement (2wks), reminders (7d, 2d, 1d), final hour. I can draft email series + 3 social posts if someone approves copy.

Alex (Crossover): We can supply a customer quote and help with newsletter push. Legal will need to pre-approve quotes.

Rae: Action owners summary:
- Omar: catalog listing + metadata + video coord (owner)
- Li: benchmark post + methodology (owner)
- Nia: webinar ops + landing page + promo (owner)
- Rae: approve copy + AE one-pager content (owner)
- Alex (Crossover): co-branded assets + quote (partner)

Rae: Any blockers? If none, we'll lock dates and kick off a short content sprint. Please flag legal needs here so we can loop Sarah early. :rocket:
